definitions.gloss: handover; delivery; transfer (of goods, property, or a building)
definitions.explanation: The act of handing something over to another party — delivering purchased goods, or turning over a completed building or piece of property to its owner.
The handing over of a person, especially a suspect or criminal, to the authorities or to another country.

examples.japanese: {家|いえ}の{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}しは{来月|らいげつ}です。
examples.english: The handover of the house is next month.

examples.japanese: {商品|しょうひん}の{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}しは{店頭|てんとう}で{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: Goods are handed over at the store counter.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}が{完了|かんりょう}し、{建物|たてもの}の{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}しが{済|す}んだ。
examples.english: The construction was completed, and the handover of the building was finished.

examples.japanese: {容疑者|ようぎしゃ}の{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}しを{求|もと}める。
examples.english: To demand the surrender of the suspect.

examples.japanese: {逃亡犯|とうぼうはん}の{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}しに{応|おう}じた。
examples.english: They complied with the extradition of the fugitive.

examples.japanese: {両国|りょうこく}は{犯罪者|はんざいしゃ}の{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}しについて{条約|じょうやく}を{結|むす}んでいる。
examples.english: The two countries have concluded a treaty on the extradition of criminals.

notes:
The noun form of {引|ひ}き{渡|わた}す — the act of handing something, or someone, over to another party. It ranges from the delivery of goods and the turnover of a completed building to the legal surrender or extradition of a person.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {引|ひ}き{渡|わた}しを{行|おこな}う: to carry out a handover
- {引|ひ}き{渡|わた}しを{受|う}ける: to take delivery
- {身柄|みがら}の{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}し: surrender of custody

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {譲渡|じょうと}: transfer of rights or ownership — legal and financial
- {受|う}け{渡|わた}し: handover; delivery — stresses the exchange between two parties, common in transactions
